text: If the FSOC relies on inaccurate Form PF data in its systemic risk assessment, its work on private funds may itself be erroneous.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008

isBasedOn.name: The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: If FSOC relies on Form PF data in its systemic risk assessment that is subject to inaccuracies, it appears possible that FSOC's work pertaining to private funds could in turn be subject to errors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: FSOC reliance on Form PF data subject to inaccuracies
